title: Scroll areas drawn over scroll containers, a range and details
blurb: Five scrolling and resizing controls from the ui-feed collection, rebuilt around native elements: a paint chart whose chips stack as they scroll away, a list that turns over beside the thumb you hold, a bank statement with sticky days, a seismograph split by a range input and the running order of a record in two details.
question: Can a real scroll container, with its wheel, touch and keys, be drawn in pieces and bent out of shape by the canvas while it carries on scrolling natively?
result: Yes. Each scroll container scrolled itself by wheel, swipe and keys while the canvas drew it squashed, in pieces or under a shrinking heading, and position: sticky worked inside it. Drawn thumbs over empty divs dragged it, and a range input worked as a split bar. Nothing here is verified on a phone.
